comments.author: lisa
comments.body:
@George sorry maybe i wasnt clear: imeant to say,

1. EA does not exist in the Original Skill list.
2. EA is only available as a Optional skill. 2.1 only if it appears in the option list for the ship you choose to be looking at.

and for those like George, who require that i make a point of the obvious
2.1 only if it appears in the option list for the ship you choose to be looking at.

each ship has its own (not always unique) set of optional skills, the NC custom/modified ships tend to have same skills as their standard counterparts...

comments.author: Laurena
comments.body:
@Lisa Yes, EA does exist as an original skill, but it cannot be added to the cruise galleon. I added EA to a friends tow cutter for 3 original ship permits.

The original skills you can add to a ship are different from port to port, and only major cities offer EA as an original skill. You have to invest to get it to show up.

comments.author: Laurena
comments.body: And for clarity, Claudia is correct. Clicking the button on the ship data at the top that says "Build original ship" will tell you what skills can be added as original skills for that particular ship. If its not on the list, it cannot be added. Keep in mind, some skills such as EA and direct hit prevention can only be added in major cities, and you need to invest to get it to show in the list
